_readme: Approved traveller reports, keyed by guide slug. Each entry: { month: 'August 2026', name: 'First', passport: 'US', where: 'airline check-in' | 'immigration' | 'visa application' | 'not asked', report: '1-3 sentences' }. NOTHING auto-publishes: submissions arrive as PostHog events (traveller_report_submitted) plus an email to lc@peregrin.travel, and useful ones are added here by hand in a later run. Newest first per country; the page shows at most 5.
